raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Stack (2/6), merge in order: [#44851](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44851) → [#44852](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44852) → [#44853](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44853) → [#44854](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44854) → [#44863](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44863) → [#44869](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44869)

## Motivation

Frozen-KV MTP on XPU fails under the synchronous scheduler and uses the draft's dummy KV pool when determining sliding-window translation. It also leaves recurrent assistant forwards eager despite the shared graph runner supporting XPU.

## Modifications

- Accept and forward `pp_proxy_tensors` through target prefill and verification.
- Bind frozen draft attention to the target allocator's KV pool and skip write-slot metadata for this read-only draft.
- Enable frozen-KV draft graph capture on XPU, with a serving regression and an E2B/BMG MTP recipe.

Depends on #44851. No CPU-offload changes or weight quantization.

## Accuracy Tests

Five attention backend unit tests pass, including a pool-ownership regression that fails before the fix. The XPU MTP serving fixture checks repeated decode, per-request verification statistics, and nonzero draft capture. Six greedy prompts match ordinary decoding, including 1,016- and 1,814-token prompts crossing the sliding-window boundary.

GSM8K via `sgl-eval==0.1.3`: 82.5%/200, zero errors, two truncated responses. This is a smoke check, not proof of accuracy improvement or equivalence.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same physical Intel Arc Pro B70, TP1 BF16, unchanged target weights, context 8,192, KV capacity 32,768, max running requests 8; MTP top-k 1, three draft steps/four verification tokens. OpenAI chat benchmark, fixed 256 output tokens, two repeats; 8 requests at concurrency 1 and 32 at concurrency 8.

| Concurrency | Ordinary TPOT | Corrected eager MTP | Captured MTP |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 11.168 ms | 7.742 ms | 4.282 ms |
| 8 | 11.774 ms | 9.372 ms | 5.914 ms |

Capture alone improves TPOT by 1.81x/1.58x over corrected eager MTP. The total 2.61x/1.99x over ordinary decoding also includes speculative decoding's benefit.

## Checklist

- [x] Pre-commit checks and attention unit tests.
- [x] XPU serving regressions and greedy parity.
- [x] Accuracy and serving benchmarks.
- [x] Cookbook and generated-command checks.

@@ -105,6 +105,8 @@ The Gemma 4 series offers models in various sizes and architectures, optimized f
 
 The **E2B + BMG** configuration serves text on one Intel Arc Pro B70 with the Intel XPU attention backend and decode graphs. Use an [Intel XPU installation](/docs/hardware-platforms/xpu). This configuration uses `--language-model-only` to omit the vision/audio encoders and rejects image, video, and audio requests. For multimodal requests, omit that flag and use `--attention-backend triton` for bidirectional image attention.
 
+For **E2B + BMG**, enable **Speculative Decoding (MTP)** to capture the frozen-KV assistant's recurrent draft loop in XPU graphs. This recipe uses three draft steps, four verification tokens, and a maximum of eight concurrent requests. The target model verifies the assistant's proposals using its original weights.
+
 ### 3.2 Configuration Tips
 
 - SGLang automatically selects the Triton attention backend for Gemma 4 models (required for bidirectional image-token attention during prefill).

+class TestFrozenKVPoolBinding(CustomTestCase):
+    """A frozen draft must translate through target SWA, not its dummy pool."""
+
+    def test_frozen_and_independent_draft_pool_ownership(self):
+        from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_info import SpeculativeAlgorithm
+
+        dummy_pool = object()
+        target_pool = MagicMock(spec=xpu_backend.SWAKVPool, swa_layer_nums=1)
+        runner = SimpleNamespace(
+            model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                context_len=128,

+            ),
+            token_to_kv_pool=dummy_pool,
+            token_to_kv_pool_allocator=SimpleNamespace(get_kvcache=lambda: target_pool),
+            kv_cache_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            kv_cache_dtype_str="bfloat16",
+            page_size=64,
+            is_hybrid_swa=True,
+            is_draft_worker=True,

+            for algorithm, expected_pool, translates_swa in (
+                (SpeculativeAlgorithm.FROZEN_KV_MTP, target_pool, True),
+                (SpeculativeAlgorithm.EAGLE, dummy_pool, False),
+            ):
+                with self.subTest(algorithm=algorithm):
+                    runner.spec_algorithm = algorithm
+                    backend = XPUAttentionBackend(runner)
